exercicio.statement:
Christian and Miranda both go to Carmite Middle School. They measured the distance between their home and the school to figure out who lives closer to the school. Use the number line to find out.
Christian lives 4/10 of a mile from the school.
Miranda lives 2/5 of a mile from the school.
Who lives closer to school?
